title: Virtual Mahjong 2: My Fair Lady
native_title: ＶＩＲＴＵＡＬ麻雀Ⅱ ～マイ・フェアー・レディ～
overview:
An industry first!! "Raising Polygon Mahjong" arrives

"Aya", a resident of the virtual world, transforms in seven ways through cosplay!! And since she's made of polygons, you can see her from all sorts of angles!! Maybe you'll even get to see ???... Keep scoring high with the hints "Aya" gives you, and a moving best ending awaits...

Aim to become a princess!!

No cheating whatsoever!! Authentic four-player mahjong!! "Ari-ari" rules with open tanyao and atozuke allowed!!

"Virtual Mahjong" included - a great deal!!

業界初！！“育成ポリゴン麻雀”登場

バーチャルワールドの住人“アヤ”がコスプレで七変化！！しかもポリゴンだからいろんな角度から見れちゃうゾ！！もしかしたら???まで見えるかも…！？“アヤ”が出すヒントで高得点を出し続けると、そこには感動のベストエンディングが…。

目指せプリンセス！！

イカサマ一切無し！！本格4人打ち麻雀！！喰断、後付け有りの「ありあり」ルール！！

「バーチャル麻雀」同梱でとってもお得！！
